To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the long-range spin — spin coupling constants 2JN 15 H4 and 5JN15 H4 are useful tools for the stereochemical characterization of furan oximes.

the long-range 3-bond N15H1 spin — spin coupling constants are sensitive to the configuration of oximes of aromatic aldehydes, and that the 2J(N15H1) values for the E — and Z — isomers of these compounds differ by 2.5 — 3.0 Hz.

the 2JH15Hald coupling constants are very useful in the stereochemical analysis, while the 5JN15N15Hald and 5JN5H15Nald constants can be utilized to investigate the three-dimensional structure of the oximes of furan derivatives.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the application of N15H15 spin-spin coupling constants to the determination of the configurations and the three-dimensional structures and to the stereochemical analysis for oximes of the heterocyclic compounds.
the application of heteronuclear spin-spin coupling constants for the determination of the three-dimensional structure and stereochemistry of organic compounds.
the investigation of the structure of furfural oxime and its acylated derivatives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the N15H1 spin-spin coupling constants, in conjunction with the 2JH4H5 spin-spin coupling constants and 1H NMR chemical shifts, provide a powerful tool for the stereochemical investigation of the oximes of the substituted furans.
the N—O bond in the oximes of furfurals has a considerable degree of double bond character.
2JN1 5Hald and 5JN15 H4 are the most useful constants for the determination of configurations of the oxime of the furan system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the 2JHaldN15 values for the E isomers are 4.5–6 Hz and those for the Z isomers are 1–2.5 Hz; the 5JH4N15 values are 0.5–1 Hz for the E isomer and 1.5–2 Hz for the Z isomer; and the 3JH3N15 values are about 1.5 Hz for the E and the Z isomers.
we have developed a new method for the determination of the configurations of oximes of aldehydes with a furan ring.
the long-range spin — Spin coupling constant of the nitrogen atom with a hydrogen atom in the furan ring can be used for the stereochemical investigation of oximes of this series.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of NMR in the determination of structure is not limited to the analysis of the chemical shifts and coupling constants of the protons of the organic molecule.
the N15H1 spin — Spin couplings are very useful for the structural analysis of oximes.
the 3JN15H3 and 3JN1H3 coupling constants are very sensitive to the conformation of the furan side chain.
